secretCheck.scope: All indexed text blobs; exact local secret values and recognizable credential patterns; no values recorded

whitespace.exception: Sealed parent Markdown hard line breaks and generated evidence bytes are preserved exactly; they are outside the authored-code whitespace check.

receiptScope: Records the staged tree before this receipt is added. Exact image equality is bound to the completed art verification; this audit compares indexed hashes and does not rerun rendering or provider checks.
